    (finset_one_inclusion_pairs 𝓕).card :=
  by
  apply Finset.card_bij (fun x _ => ((x.1 : Finset α), (x.2 : Finset α)))
  · …
apply Finset.card_bij (fun x _ => ((x.1 : Finset α), (x.2 : Finset α)))
simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hx
simp only [finset_one_inclusion_pairs, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at hb

have key : 2 * (finset_one_inclusion_graph 𝓕).edgeFinset.card = (finset_one_inclusion_pairs 𝓕).card :=
  by
  rw [← hbij]
  convert SimpleGraph.two_mul_card_edgeFinset (finset_one_inclusion_graph 𝓕)
have h2 : 2 * (finset_one_inclusion_graph 𝓕).edgeFinset.card ≤ 2 * (d * 𝓕.card) := by rw [key]; exact hpairs
